subtasks.goal: Investigate and resolve the duplicate-CRM-incident complaint from Revenue Ops. Steps: (1) List all open (status new, open, and escalated) CRM tickets via list_tickets filtered by service=crm, and read the full detail (get_ticket) of each one to understand the reported problem, its impact scope, creation time, and any existing links/comments. (2) Identify which of these tickets genuinely describe the same underlying incident (same root cause/problem, not just superficially similar symptoms) -- read carefully, since only true duplicates should be consolidated; anything different must be left untouched. (3) For the set of genuine duplicates, choose the earliest-created ticket as the survivor. Determine the correct SLA deadline for the survivor: it must be the earliest SLA deadline among the whole duplicate set (if some duplicates have no deadline yet, they should not force an earlier deadline than one already committed -- use the earliest deadline that has actually been committed among the set; if none have a deadline yet, compute one via get_current_time plus the response target for the correct severity per the escalation matrix once severity is known). (4) Call merge_tickets with the chosen survivor, the other duplicate ticket ids, and the correct slaDueAt. (5) After merging, call get_escalation_matrix for the crm service to determine the correct severity for the survivor's (post-merge, broadest) impact scope, and call set_severity on the survivor accordingly. (6) Use get_current_time and then get_oncall for the rotation that owns CRM per the escalation matrix, resolved 'at' the survivor's SLA deadline (not the current time), to find the correct on-call engineer, and call assign_ticket to assign the survivor to that engineer. (7) Post a comment on the survivor ticket summarizing which tickets were merged into it and why they were judged duplicates. (8) Leave any open CRM tickets that are not genuine duplicates of this incident completely unmodified. Do not touch tickets belonging to other services (vpn, payroll, build-pipeline).
